reviews.t: Teeth feel so clean you'd think you just came from the dentist
reviews.x: Only without the scraping!  My teeth feel so smooth and clean, just like they'd been cleaned by the dentist.  I was an agressive brusher before, but this is amazing.  My gums even feel so much stronger now.  I've noticed my teeth look whiter now than they ever have as well.  I've noticed this toothbrush on the Friday sale, several different weeks.  If you're looking to buy, I highly recommend doing it on a Friday, check out the Friday sale.

This is the first time I have ever used an electric toothbrush, so I can't compare it to others.  But I can compare it to a regular toothbrush....and it totally blows away regular toothbrushes.  I have been using it for about 3 weeks now and my teeth are noticeably whiter, and they feel smooth just like when a dentist cleans them. Every time I go to the dentist I get the same thing said to me at the end of the actual dentist inspection, "You have great looking teeth Mr. Cole. But you don't floss do you?" I hate when he asks me that cause I know that he knows that I don't. That's why my gums are inflamed usually (not bad or anything). Even my dentist/hygenist noticed a huge difference once I started using the sonicare, my teeth were whiter and she found she did less scrapping and cleaning than her other patients.  When the battery died after 4 yrs, there was no question that I was getting another one. reviews.t: Simply put, this brush saved my teeth
reviews.x: I'll be honest - I don't have good teeth genes. Both my parents have multiple crowns, and despite my efforts (and best attempts to make up for neglecting my teeth when I had braces), cavities would always appear. About a year ago I noticed a funny taste coming out of the base of my back teeth. It wouldn't go away even though I tried my darnedest to brush and floss back there. I had them checked out, and the dentist recommended I get 3 of those back teeth crowned, since decay was starting to go u

That's what prompted this review, because they would not replace mine after it fell apart two weeks after purchasing a replacement.  They manufacturer these things to disintegrate so you will continue to buy replacements - planned obsolescence. However, I suspect their China supplier is skimping on the plastic

Why did I wait so long to buy one of these?? Definitely cleaner teeth with this toothbrush.  I have always had a hard time getting to my back molars before this toothbrush.  The head on this is smaller than a standard toothbrush, but being automated, you dont have to jam it against the back of your cheekbone to try to get to your rear molars.  Came with a spare toothbrush head.  I admit that I drink alot of coffee and use tobacco products, and I have noticed significant whiter and cleaner teeth

reviews.t: excellent, effective brush, but louder than before
reviews.x: My old, original Sonicare brush died, and since I had such good luck and success with the toothbrush in the past, I got the e5500 as my replacement.  Compared to the original Sonicare, the e5500 has some nice improvements: easier to clean charging base, smaller brush-head and slimmer, easier to grip handle. The toothbrush cleans very effectively and I have no reservations in recommending this brush to anyone.  My only complaint is that I believe the brush is louder than previous models. Not loud

My dentist highly recommends the Sonicare line, and I can honestly say that my dental appointments have been much nicer (i.e. lower numbers of problems) since I started using them about five years ago.  This model is great in that it has the automatic beep every 30 seconds to let you know to move to the next quadrant of your mouth.  The smaller head also allows you to get into the more difficult-to-reach parts of your mouth.
This thing is loud!  You can't brush your upper teeth without it vibrating loudly against your lower and vice versa.  And remember.  Once you use it it's not returnable.  Worst $80 I've ever lost.

reviews.t: Went from 6 mm to 3 mm in 2 months
reviews.x: This toothbrush saved me from expensive gum cleaning.  I made an appointment to get my 6mm gum pockets treated with cleaning agents and antibiotics.  After hearing that I bought this toothbrush and set to work while my appointment came near.  Due to scheduling conflicts my appointment ended up getting delayed 2 months. reviews.t: Best purchase I've made for myself in years.
reviews.x: I love this toothbrush! Not only am I brushing longer but more often.  Brushing my teeth has become a very relaxing experience and my teeth definitely are whiter and cleaner. Cleared up my bleeding gums which were becoming a major problem even though I had been using my cybersonic toothbrush for years. The timing mechanism is extremely helpful. Definitely worth the investment.  Best price anywhere on a gold box special and great service.
This new design works better than previous designs.  The brush and stem fit better in the mouth with less splash and the brush better fits the contour of the teeth.

reviews.t: Skimpy on quality, but worth it for a healthy mouth
reviews.x: I ordered my Sonicare 3 months ago. I believed the first unit to be defective because the toothbrush head would not screw on flush with the base. Ultimately, this would cause a lot of bacteria to build up so I sent for a replacement. Amazon was great about sending a new one right out and I received it within a couple days. reviews.t: Sonicare is the best hands down!
reviews.x: This review is for people who are trying to decide on the Sonicare or a Braun Oral B (or ANY spin brush for that matter).  My previous toothbrush was an Braun Oral B, and in my experience, the Sonicare is way superior.  First of all, the Oral B has a rotating head.  Well, after several uses, I've noticed that the head starts getting loose and my lips and cheeks sometimes get pinched in the gap between the head and the neck of the brush.  This causes me to have to change the brush even before it'
After 8 months of use once a day by one mature adult the toothbrush failed completely.  It will not even turn on.  I would not recommend the e5500 Power Toothbrush to anyone.

reviews.t: Great If You Want A Slime Factory - But There's a Cure

It's even worse inside the top of the handle, visible when the brushing element is unscrewed.  If you want to avoid a disgusting mess, you really need to disassemble this unit every day for a thorough cleaning.  That's a lot to ask for a tool that is supposed to make our lives easier.  I used a previous Sonicare model for years without ever encountering this issue.  My wife's to

It comes with two heads, which we use for me and the wife.  I think that my teeth have gotten a shade lighter, my teeth are pretty coffee and smoke stained. I've had Sonicare electric toothbrushes for more than 10 years. The Elite model was my favorite, but it failed prematurely due to a problematic on/off switch (rubber covering failed).  The first time, it failed under warranty, but the second failure wasn't covered (they'll only replace it once).  Based on feedback from a Sonicare customer service rep, I recently replaced it with the more basic Sonicare Essence e5500 model; but it was big, clunky and noisy, so I returned it. Instead I purchased a

My disappointment is that it's not built nearly as well as my older model and probably won't last as long; seems cheap by comparison. Also, no matter how well you wipe it after use, it still leaks water from the joint of the holder and the brush head. This transfers to the charger.  Small point perhaps, but sloppy. As with my older model, the inside cavity must be cleaned I'd judge weekly. My older brush from Philips did not leak though. I'm thinking of returning the e5500  toothbrush and buying

The Sonicare Essence 5500 Power Toothbrush is everything I wanted it to be, with one exception.  The 30 second "beep" that signifies moving on to the next quadrant needs to be a little louder.  But, hey, I can live with that because this product lived up to its hype, and my teeth have never felt cleaner.  Well worth the purchase.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently report cleaner-feeling teeth, with many saying their teeth feel smooth and dentist-clean after use.
Several reviewers note whiter teeth or improved gum health after using the brush.
Some reviewers complain the brush is loud or noisy compared to expectations or earlier models.
A few reviewers report durability problems, including a disintegrating collar and mold inside the unit.
Some reviewers find the standard brush heads too stiff or hard.
